_comment: Week 5 detour scenario. Same landmark-map schema as week3 (markers + target B + camera), PLUS an obstacle and closed-loop sim params. The drone heads north to B, an obstacle sits on the direct line, it detours EAST around it, then resumes. Markers line the corridor incl. the detour apex so a correction can fire DURING the maneuver.
_marker_note: Markers line the whole surveyed route: approach (x=0), the east detour arc, and the diagonal resume back to B. This is how a real site is marked -- along the planned corridor, including the known obstacle bypass.

obstacle._comment: Obstacle sensing is reactive on the REAL camera (Rohan's optical-flow module); it uses true geometry, so avoidance works even when localization has drifted.
